race.comment: VOSTOKOVA (7) win record hardly excites but looking for this trip at her fifth race start. Shouldered the 60kg for a plugging fifth over 1350m at Ipswich a week-and-a-half ago. Proven at the distance and drops 6kg in weight after the claim. Leading contender. OCCUPATION (2) well bred gelding rewarded for his consistency at start four with a dominant victory over 1550m at Murwillumbah in the small field. Gets a similar set up again and expected to go on with it now. KHARIF (1) finally got the Maiden win out of the way two back, then finished a gritty second over 1540m at the Gold Coast Poly. Tongue tie goes on and confidence is high. SHE'S A DAME (6) recorded her maiden success last time over 1400m at Ballina after racing handy. Has the benefit of a recent trial placing and rates a place chance
